fact: The World Bank IEG review of the Strategic Cities Project (closed 26 November 2020) reports that LGRCIS, which bills by bar-coded invoices and issues electronic receipts, was scaled up from 8 LGAs to all 185 mainland LGAs, with the project financed by IDA credits.
title: Implementation Completion Report (ICR) Review: TZ-Strategic Cities Project (P111153)
publisher: World Bank Group, Independent Evaluation Group
